# EW Color Picker

> 事件驱动 + 插件化的现代颜色选择器，支持 Hex / RGB / HSL、透明度、中英文文档。

Event-driven, plugin-based color picker with Hex / RGB / HSL support, alpha channel, and full plugin architecture.

- 官网 / Website: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/
- 仓库 / Repository: https://github.com/eveningwater/ew-color-picker
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker

## 中文文档

- [回调](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/api/callbacks): 核心回调与各插件回调的签名、触发时机，以及回调与事件的差异对比。
- [事件](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/api/events): change、toggle、sure、clear、options-update、mode-change、destroy 七个事件的触发时机、参数与监听规则。
- [实例方法](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/api/methods): ewColorPicker 实例方法完整参考：挂载、改色、开合面板、更新配置、事件与销毁。
- [配置项](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/api/options): EW Color Picker 全部构造配置项的完整参考：类型、默认值与行为说明。
- [样式与类名](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/api/styles): 样式入口、CSS 变量、全部类名分组与主题定制方式。
- [在线演示](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/examples/demo): 在浏览器中直接体验 EW Color Picker：取色、开合面板、查看实时事件日志。
- [示例集](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/examples/): EW Color Picker 的 12 个典型用法：基础、布局、预设色、按钮、事件、定位、动画、禁用、模式、API、数字输入、多实例。
- [竞品对比与产品定位](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/guide/comparison): 对比 Pickr、iro.js、Coloris、react-colorful、react-color 等成熟颜色选择器，说明 EW Color Picker 的差异、优势、局限与适用场景。
- [核心概念](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/guide/concepts): 理解实例级事件总线、挂载点、插件执行顺序、单一改色入口与实例隔离。
- [框架集成](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/guide/framework-integration): 在 React、Vue 3、Angular 与 Solid 中集成 EW Color Picker 的最小封装写法、生命周期清理与受控同步。
- [快速开始](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/guide/getting-started): 几分钟内创建第一个 EW Color Picker 实例：容器、配置、事件、方法与销毁。
- [项目介绍](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/guide/): EW Color Picker 是事件驱动、插件化的颜色选择器。了解核心职责、13 个包的划分与数据流。
- [安装](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/guide/installation): 通过 pnpm/npm/yarn、UMD 脚本或按需子包安装 EW Color Picker，开发环境需要 Node 20.10+。
- [编写自定义插件](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/guide/plugin-dev): 按 pluginName、applyOrder、构造函数、挂载点与事件的约定编写可注册、可销毁的自定义插件。
- [插件化架构](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/)
- [Alpha 透明度滑块插件](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/alpha): Alpha 插件为 EW Color Picker 增加 0–1 透明度滑块，输出 rgba 颜色，支持水平/垂直方向与运行时开关。
- [Box 颜色盒插件](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/box): Box 插件是 EW Color Picker 的触发器：渲染当前颜色色块，点击打开或关闭面板，并负责图标颜色随背景自适应。
- [Button 按钮插件](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/button): Button 插件渲染清空与确定按钮，支持自定义文案、禁用、动态显隐，并触发 clear / sure 事件。
- [ColorMode 颜色模式插件](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/color-mode): 在 Hex / RGB / HSL 三种颜色模式之间切换，并驱动分通道输入组，触发 mode-change 事件。
- [Console 控制台插件](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/console): Console 插件在浏览器控制台输出版本与作者信息，全页面仅打印一次，可关闭。
- [Hue 色相滑块插件](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/hue): Hue 插件渲染 0–360 度色相滑块，支持水平/垂直方向、点击跳转、拖拽与运行时开关。
- [插件总览](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/): EW Color Picker 的插件体系：11 个内置插件的职责、注册顺序与包名，以及插件之间如何协作完成颜色选择。
- [InputNumber 数字输入框插件](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/input-number): InputNumber 插件与底层 InputNumber 组件的配置、方法、尺寸与事件，用于 RGB/HSL 分通道数值输入。
- [Input 颜色输入框插件](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/input): Input 插件提供可直接输入 hex/rgb/rgba/hsl/hsla 的文本框，带校验、防抖与禁用态。
- [Panel 颜色面板插件](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/panel): Panel 插件渲染饱和度/明度二维选择面板，支持拖拽与触摸、自动定位、面板尺寸自适应。
- [Predefine 预定义颜色插件](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/predefine): 用 predefineColor 配置一组快捷色块，支持逐项禁用、运行时更新与点击高亮。

## English Docs

- [Callbacks](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/api/callbacks): Core and plugin-level callbacks: changeColor, sure, clear, togglePicker, onClick, onChange, changeMode and their signatures.
- [Events](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/api/events): Change, toggle, sure, clear, options-update, mode-change and destroy events: payloads, timing and listener rules.
- [Methods](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/api/methods): Full reference for ewColorPicker instance methods: mount, setColor, getColor, updateOptions, showPanel, events and destroy.
- [Options](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/api/options): Complete reference for every EW Color Picker constructor option, default value, type and behaviour.
- [Styles & Classes](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/api/styles): Stylesheet entries, CSS variables, class name groups and theming tips for EW Color Picker.
- [Live Demo](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/examples/demo): Try EW Color Picker in the browser: pick colors, toggle the panel and watch the realtime event log.
- [Examples](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/examples/): Twelve typical EW Color Picker scenarios: basic, layout, presets, buttons, events, placement, animation, disabled, modes, API, numeric inputs, multiple instances.
- [Comparison & Positioning](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/comparison): How EW Color Picker compares with Pickr, iro.js, Coloris, react-colorful and react-color, and where it fits.
- [Core Concepts](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/concepts): Understand the instance-level event bus, mount points, plugin apply order, single color entry and instance isolation.
- [Framework Integration](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/framework-integration): Minimal integration patterns for EW Color Picker in React, Vue 3, Angular and Solid, including lifecycle cleanup and controlled-value sync.
- [Quick Start](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/getting-started): Create your first EW Color Picker instance in minutes: container, options, events, methods and cleanup.
- [Introduction](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/): EW Color Picker is an event-driven, plugin-based color picker. Learn what the core does and how the 13 packages fit together.
- [Installation](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/installation): Install EW Color Picker via npm, pnpm, yarn, UMD script, or per-package imports. Requires Node 20.10+ for development.
- [Writing a Plugin](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/plugin-dev): Build a custom EW Color Picker plugin with pluginName, applyOrder, constructor, mount points, events and TypeScript type augmentation.
- [Plugin Architecture](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/)
- [Alpha Plugin](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/alpha): The Alpha plugin adds a 0–1 opacity slider, outputs rgba colors, and supports horizontal/vertical orientation.
- [Box Plugin](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/box): The Box plugin renders the trigger swatch, toggles the panel, and adapts icon color to background luminance.
- [Button Plugin](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/button): Clear and Sure buttons: custom labels, visibility toggles, disabled state, clear/sure events and callbacks.
- [ColorMode Plugin](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/color-mode): Switch between Hex / RGB / HSL, rebuild channel inputs, and listen to the mode-change event.
- [Console Plugin](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/console): The Console plugin prints a styled version banner once per page and can be omitted by registering plugins manually.
- [Hue Plugin](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/hue): The Hue plugin renders a 0–360° slider with horizontal/vertical orientation, click, drag and runtime toggle.
- [Plugin Overview](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/): The EW Color Picker plugin system: 11 built-in plugins, registration order, mount points and collaboration.
- [InputNumber Plugin](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/input-number): The InputNumber plugin and standalone component: options, methods, sizes and events for numeric color inputs.
- [Input Plugin](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/input): The Input plugin provides a validated hex/rgb/hsl text field with debounce and disabled state.
- [Panel Plugin](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/panel): The Panel plugin renders the saturation/value area with drag, touch support, auto placement and dynamic sizing.
- [Predefine Plugin](https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/predefine): Configure quick swatches with predefineColor, disable individual items, and update them at runtime.
